content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for District Panchayat Bemetara Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://bemetara.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 23-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by District Panchayat Bemetara for filling various contractual positions under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Gramin.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies have been announced for Assistant Grade-03 and Data Entry Operator posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for District Panchayat Bemetara Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 23 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications through offline mode via registered post or speed post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for applicants is between 21 years and 40 years as per the recruitment guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for Assistant Grade-03?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a graduation degree or 12th pass along with a Modern Office Management diploma, 1-year computer diploma, and required typing speed.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Data Entry Operator post is 23,350/- per month under Level 6.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for any of the categories.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a merit list based on academic qualifications and a skill test.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: The application form must be sent in a closed envelope to the office of the Chief Executive Officer, District Panchayat Bemetara.
